projects.title: AutoDiffuse: Developing Stable Diffusion AI prompts and Image In-painting with OpenAI API

details.description:
•Users upload an image, then our SAM model segments it into parts and they are displayed to the users
who select an area to edit/remove.
•Users provide a description (like "a cat" or "a tree") of what they want in place of the selected image
segment.
•Then our model seamlessly replaces the selected area by leveraging the OpenAI GPT-3.5 and
StableDiffusion model with the user-provided details.

technical_papers.title: Electromagnetic and Thermal Analysis of Permanent Magnet BLDC Wiper Motor

details.description: This paper compares the different permanent magnet materials for a wiper application, especially front wiper system. Simulation-based study on electromagnetic performance and thermal predictions are discussed. Initially, the design of a brushless direct current (BLDC) motor is made for the required power of 52 Watts within a pack size of 56 * 35 mm. Results obtained by using different types of permanent magnets in the same pack size are carefully studied and compared. Finally, the thermal characteristics of the designed motors are predicted and compared.

technical_papers.title: Electromagnetic Analysis of Permanent Magnet Brushed DC Motor for Automotive Applications—Part 1

details.description: Permanent magnet brushed DC (PMBDC) motors are mostly preferred in many automotive applications because of better power density and easier control. Five different automotive applications such as electric parking brake (EPB), power seat, power window, sunroof drive, and tire air pump are chosen and discussed in this paper. A step-by-step electromagnetic analysis is carried out for all the designed models. Low-cost ferrite-based magnets are used for cost reduction keeping the efficiency as high above 77% in all the models. Comparison on performance and cost are discussed in the conclusion section.

technical_papers.title: Electromagnetic Analysis of Permanent Magnet Brushed Direct Current Motors for Automotive Applications—Part 2

details.description: This paper describes the modelling and electromagnetic analysis of Permanent Magnet Brushed Direct Current (PMBDC) motor using Finite Element Analysis (FEA) software packages. The designed motors referred in this analysis are fit for use in applications of the electronic throttle control and exhaust gas recirculation in automobiles. Performances of the designed PMBDC models are compared with the traditionally used machines. Three PMBDC models with different operating characteristics are proposed for the two applications. Each model is suitable for use in both applications. Cost analysis of the motors is also carried out, and comparison with the traditionally used machines is done.

technical_papers.title: High-Voltage Electric Water Pump for the Application of Electric Vehicle—Modeling, Design and Analysis

details.description: This paper presents the designing and electromagnetic analysis of permanent magnet brushless DC (PMBLDC) motor using finite element analysis software packages for high-voltage water pump application. The designed water pump motor is suitable for application in the battery pack cooling system used in electric vehicles (EVs). Two PMBLDC models based on 200 volt system and 300 volt system are proposed for the water pump application. Component-wise designing procedure is explained for the PMBLDC motor to obtain efficiency improvement and cost reduction compared to the prominently used models in the industry. Elaborate study on performance estimation is carried out for both the models using electromagnetic analysis.

technical_papers.title: Spoke-Type and Surface-Mounted BLDC Motor for Automotive Applications—A Brief Comparison

details.description: Permanent magnet brushless DC (PMBLDC) motor has been promoted rapidly in automotive applications. Current automotive vehicle demands more than 40 different types of applications which require rotating motors. This paper compares the surface-mounted and spoke-type PMBLDC motor for the application such as anti-lock braking systems, pedal adjusters, and seat belt pretensioners. Technical specifications, electromagnetic analysis, magnet mass optimization, and cost are discussed in detail. Advantages of both the configurations are compared and concluded finally.

technical_papers.title: PMBLDC Motor Design and Analysis for Automotive Applications

details.description: Modeling of brushless direct current (BLDC) motor for the application of lumbar support, headrest and lift gate is carried out in this paper. Two separate models have been simulated using finite element software packages for the applications. One of the models is based on surface-mounted configuration of the BLDC motor, while the other is based on spoke-type configuration. The surface-type and spoke-type models procure their names based on the mounting of permanent magnets, which are an integral component of any BLDC machine. Extensive comparison has been carried out between the designed models. Critical parameters such as constituent weights, efficiency, output power, torque, speed, etc. are compared. Performances of the designed machines are depicted using graphical portrayal. Parameters such as locked rotor torque, no load speed, maximum efficiency, maximum output power, etc. are also compared.

details.description:
Developed Integrated Software for an autonomous
traffic monitoring signal system to increase the
efficiency of the traditional traffic system.

the traffic signals. The signals nearby the area are connected
to give better throughput. Also, check
the signal violation done by the vehicles and penalize them.
• This system is integration of web applications, Machine
learning algorithms, Cloud computing, Data analytics.

projects.title: BREAST CANCER CLASSIFICATION USING ML APPROACH

details.description:
 As part of B.Tech. Major Project (6th
-8
th Semester, Team of Four). 
 In this project Light GBM Model was used to classify breast cancer into benign or malignant and achieve 
the highest accuracy model to attain the maximum result possible by following steps. 
 Firstly, we collect the data and preprocess the data, which is explained below, next we split the data into 
70% and 30% format as train and test data and we train the data with an algorithm and use it to predict 
the answer. 
 The result that we came to know is that Light GBM algorithm is efficient and easy to implement while 
working on diagnostic dataset. Where from 30 features on removing the outliers, we obtained 16 
features were the ones that were relevant to contributing immensely to the final accuracy of the model. 
 The obtained accuracy is 84%. Among all the five algorithms that were used, Light GBM provided us with 
the highest accuracy of 97.07%. Logistic Regression which gave accuracy of 92%, Random Forest 
Algorithm which gave accuracy of 80%, and XG Boost Algorithm which gave accuracy of 83%.

details.description: The objective of this web application is to predict lowest price of the flight ticket excluding some flights. Random Forest Regressor has been used for prediction.

technical_papers.title: Flight price prediction using machine learning algorithm.

details.description: A lot of factors that affect the overall price of airline tickets, including the airline, the date of travel, source, destination, route, duration, and so on. Each provider seems to have its own unique set regulations and methods for determining pricing. Recent breakthroughs in Machine Learning (ML) allow for the inference of such principles as well as the modelling of price volatility. This article is a study conducted on predicting flight prices.

technical_papers.title: Study on Work-Life Balance of Women's Employees in various hospitals in Surat-City

details.description: Researching work-life balance for women in Surat city hospitals, I focus on the challenges faced due to demanding schedules and rotating shifts. Juggling work and personal responsibilities, especially caregiving, is a struggle. Some hospitals offer solutions like flexible scheduling and remote work. Initiatives promoting gender equality and career advancement for women contribute to enhancing work-life balance in this context.

work_experiences.job_description:
Flight Delay Prediction Based on Weather and Aircraft Attributes – Data Science
and Machine Learning
The project likely involved data collection and preprocessing, feature engineering, and the
application of machine learning models to predict flight delays. The project's success would
have been measured by the accuracy of its predictions and its ability to help airlines reduce
flight delays.

projects.title: PLAGIARISM DETECTION - PYTHON AND SCIENTIFIC PYTHON

details.description:
The project involves designing and programming a Plagiarism text detector Jupyter
Notebook using machine learning techniques such as word2vec and cosine similarity. The
objective is to load student assignments from files and determine if students copied each
other by computing the similarity.

and Machine Learning

projects.title:
Authentication Bypass - Scanning using OWASP ZAP - Scanning for Open ports
and Attacking them  Cyber Security

details.description:
The first project focused on authentication bypass, which involves gaining unauthorized
access to a system or application. The second project involved using OWASP ZAP, an
open-source web application security scanner, for scanning vulnerabilities. The third
project focused on scanning open ports and attacking them, which is a common technique
used by attackers to gain unauthorized access to a system.

technical_papers.title: IoT-Based Manhole Detection and Monitoring System

details.description:
The system consists of sensors inside the manholes that detect parameters such as
temperature, gas concentration, water level, and tilt angle. The data collected by these
sensors are transmitted through IoT technology to a digital device, alerting authorities of
any issues, potential safety hazards, or maintenance needs.

details.description:
Created web-based bank transaction application with HTML, PHP, CSS, JavaScript, MySQL.
Enhanced security for high-value transactions, safeguarding sensitive data with stringent measures.
Created efficient permission system for seamless admin-customer transaction management.

Created advanced text categorization model with attention mechanism for harmful language identification.
Utilized CNNs, Bi-LSTM, and attention for enhanced classification accuracy in deep learning.
Employed model to accurately classify toxic, obscene, threatening, insulting, and identity-hateful comments.

Utilized NLP techniques to automatically generate coherent and concise text summaries
Developed a tool with broad applications, from streamlining news aggregation to enhancing document management.
The project contributes to significant time and effort savings in the processing of information-rich textual content.

Developed a driver drowsiness detection system using Raspberry Pi and Python.
 Utilized computer vision techniques to monitor facial expressions and detect signs of drowsiness in real-time.
Employed Haar Cascade which is a feature-based object detection algorithm to detect objects from images.
Implemented alarms and alerts to ensure driver safety and prevent accidents caused by driver fatigue.

technical_papers.title: Image labeling system using Active Learning and Transfer learning techniques

details.description:
Published research on International Journal of All Research Education and Scientific Methods (IJARESM), ISSN: 2455-6211, achieving over 30% reduction in data labeling efforts while increasing accuracy by 20% 
Implemented an ensemble of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with Transfer Learning, achieving a top-5 accuracy of 90% on the CIFAR-10 dataset, surpassing industry benchmarks.

technical_papers.title: CLIFF APP: A DECENTRALIZED MESSAGING PLATFORM Without SIM / INTERNET

details.description:
Won the Best Paper Award in IConIC2k23, an International Conference conducted which will be published in (i) Advances in Computer Science (ISSN: 2352-538x) (ii) AIP Conference Proceeding (Scopus Indexed).
Modular SDK to communicate data between nodes without internet / cellular through decentralized serverless architecture with Message caching, delayed transmission through GATT Protocols.

technical_papers.title:
Sweep Spot: Empowering Communities for Sustainable
Waste Management in Urban Areas

details.description: A mobile trash management system utilizes geotagged photos to streamline garbage reporting. The system, with geolocation services and a backend database, informs users about the nearest municipality handling waste. By promoting cleaner urban environments, it aims to enhance interaction with local government agencies in addressing environmental and health concerns arising from rapid urbanization.

technical_papers.title:
UNRAVELLING THE COMPLEXITY OF
EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE AND ITS
IMPACT ON DECISION MAKING

details.description: This paper explores how emotional intelligence (EI) influences decision-making, emphasizing its impact on information processing and cognitive biases. The findings suggest the importance of integrating emotional and cognitive aspects in decision-making. Practical applications include interventions for improved decision-making skills, with implications for leadership, teams, and organizational effectiveness.

projects.title: A ResNet-50 model for the detection of Diabatec Retinopathy

details.description: This output is capable of the detection of a disease Diabatec Retinopathy which comes mainly in Patients suffering from Diabates.This project uses a model called ResNet 50,which is a part from CNN.This scans the Retina images of Humans and gives the Rate of DR.This result is simplified into 5 classes.No DR,mild DR,moderate DR,Severe DR,proliferative DR.The Retina's features will be keenly observed and extracted by the model to check and analyse them.We took AUC score as a measure.We got AUC 97.7

work_experiences.job_description:
Created a Graph Based Recommendation System, which would recommend certain products to customers based on their search history in an e-commerce website.Executed SQL Commands to detect relationships between several product ids and stored their results in DuckDB Database in Parquet File Format. Used Deepwalk Methodology and Node2Vec to extract embeddings from the graph that was created by using parquet files.
Used FAISS (Facebook AI Similarity Search) library to find and cluster different nodes
